DentiQ TMJ Centre

Persistent Jaw Pain, Headaches or Clicking Sounds?

These may be signs of a Temporomandibular Joint Disorder (TMJ/TMD) — one of the most commonly misdiagnosed conditions in dentistry.

Dr. T. Balamurugan holds a Fellowship in Temporo Mandibular Disorders & Oro-Facial Pain (USA) — one of the very few specialists in Tamil Nadu with dedicated TMJ training and USA credentials. Most patients with TMJ have seen multiple doctors without a clear diagnosis. We change that.
